_about: How visible each DVMA category is to static analysis, for evaluation/flutter_eval.py. DVMA's own registry (infected_project/DVMA/config/registry/categories) gives the modules and their CWEs; this file only adds a judgement per category, made after reading the registry's descriptions and module summaries. code: the weakness is a property of code or configuration lines (cleartext URLs, weak crypto calls, plain storage, build settings). design: authorization, IPC, trust and supply-chain decisions; the code looks ordinary and the flaw is a missing or wrong check, so a finder needs the intended behaviour. runtime: AI/LLM behaviour, user consent and missing or bypassable runtime defences; these are behaviours of the running app, not patterns in its source.

kinds.code: property of code or configuration lines
kinds.design: authorization, IPC and trust decisions (needs the intended behaviour)
kinds.runtime: AI behaviour, consent and runtime defences (not visible in the source)

network.why: cleartext URLs, TLS settings and certificate callbacks are written in the code and the manifest

crypto.why: weak algorithms, fixed keys and IVs, insecure random calls

storage.why: plain key-value storage, logs, clipboard and external files are calls in the code (some modules, such as data kept in memory, are behaviour)

code_quality.why: build settings, error handling and native code

input_validation.why: deserialization, decoders and regular expressions applied to untrusted input

platform.why: exported components, intents, deep links and providers: most modules are chains of IPC trust decisions

native_bridge.why: WebView to native bridges whose flaw is a missing origin or permission check

auth.why: session, passkey, biometric and authorization logic

system_provider.why: privileged system roles (accessibility, IME, VPN, device policy) and who may drive them

supply_chain.why: trust in SDKs, package names and update artifacts; static rules see versions and sources, not what an SDK does

privacy.why: consent screens, tracking and what data reaches analytics at run time

resilience.why: root, debugger, emulator and tamper checks that are missing or bypassable at run time

agentic.why: behaviour of an AI agent: memory and tool poisoning, confused deputy

ai_ml.why: behaviour of an LLM assistant: prompt injection, output handling, model supply chain

ai_mobile.why: untrusted mobile input flowing into an LLM prompt and model output flowing back into the app
